steps.action: Import the synthetic subject manifest and declared SBOM evidence
steps.expected_state: subject and evidence associated with one owned release
steps.expected_result: Subject, source revision, evidence and policy digests are retained together
steps.on_error: Reject a missing or inconsistent manifest

steps.action: Evaluate the local policy against the imported evidence
steps.expected_state: policy decision bound to subject and evidence digests
steps.expected_result: The synthetic complete evidence satisfies the stated local policy
steps.on_error: Missing evidence is unverified, never pass

steps.expected_state: passport records subject, evidence, policy and verification status
steps.expected_result: Unsigned passport carries the subject digest and an unverified authenticity status
steps.on_error: Reject an output whose subject or evidence binding differs

steps.action: Change one byte of the subject and verify the earlier passport
steps.expected_state: previous passport remains bound to original bytes
steps.on_error: Fail closed when the changed bytes cannot be read

steps.action: Import a manifest without its evidence digest
steps.on_error: Never infer a passing policy decision

steps.action: Inspect a passport without a signature
steps.expected_result: Unsigned passport is unverified, even when policy allows
steps.on_error: Never label a digest as a trusted signature

steps.action: Verify a signature that fails cryptographic validation
steps.expected_result: Invalid signature is rejected or explicitly unverified
steps.on_error: Never promote invalid signature to trusted

steps.action: Inspect a signed passport without a trusted signer
steps.expected_state: signed and trusted remain distinct states
steps.expected_result: Signature presence alone is unverified; trusted requires valid signature and trusted signer
steps.on_error: Never infer signer trust from signature presence

steps.action: Compare offline verifier and viewer policy results
steps.expected_state: both present the same policy decision for the same passport
steps.expected_result: Viewer and offline verifier agree on the policy result
steps.on_error: Report a mismatch rather than silently choosing one result

steps.action: Restart the local service and restore the accepted portable result
steps.expected_state: subject and passport identity survive restart and restore
steps.expected_result: Restored passport retains the same subject digest and policy result
steps.on_error: Reject missing or corrupted restored evidence

execution.authority: immutable C05 operation; no latest-release authority
